title: SudokuFoss
subtitle: A strategic challenge with theme, shop, and hints. Prepare to clear the board!
instructionsText1: Use the numeric keypad or on-screen buttons to fill the Sudoku.
instructionsText2: Press Space to toggle between Pencil and Definitive mode.
instructionsExtra: Use arrow keys to move and Backspace to erase.
settingsHint: Settings are saved locally and applied immediately.
